activity.notes: Takeda Shingen displaced his father and became head of the Takeda house and ruler of Kai in 1541, building a substantial territorial authority through central Japan before his death in 1573. Consistent with ATLAS modeling for Sengoku daimyo such as Uesugi Kenshin and Oda Nobunaga, the polity is represented as a durable territorial authority rather than the Takeda family itself.

sources.title: Takeda Shingen
sources.citation_text: The compiled biography records Shingen's control of the Takeda clan and Kai from 1541 until his death on 13 May 1573, with extensive campaigns and territorial rule.
